description: Turns MIDI notes and control changes from a controller into keyboard events, so a MIDI control can fire any Rack hotkey.
notes: mappings are saved in the module's presets, so a set of them can be reused across patches.
nothing is sent until a MIDI device is picked on the display at the top, a slot is clicked, the key to send is pressed, and the MIDI note or control is then moved.
menu: Modifiers — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu: Ctrl, Alt and Shift, each added to the key that slot sends; Unmap and Clear MIDI assignment empty the slot.
Module — on a mapping slot's own right-click menu: Learn binds a module so the key is sent to that module, Show centres it on screen, and Clear releases it.
